Title: Azure Maps Mobility Services Preview will be retired on 5 October 2021

Body.Content:
The Azure Maps Mobility Services Preview will be retired on 5 October 2021. After that date, the service will no longer be available or supported. All other Azure Maps API’s and Services are unaffected by this retirement announcement.

Required action

To avoid service disruption in your applications, please review the following migration options and transition before 5 October 2021:

  • Use the Bing Maps Calculate a Route API for Azure Maps Mobility Services 'Get Transit Route API'.  
  • Use the Moovit Public Transit API's for any of the Mobility Services API's that Bing Maps for Enterprise doesn't currently support.

More information

Please refer to  Azure Maps Mobility Services Preview documentation for guidance and Microsoft Q&A for answers from community experts. If you have a support plan and you need technical help, please create a support request.
